finalCandidateScope: Two desktop/mobile favorite scenarios including real covers, cold RU/EN reader reveal, retained scene, header, locale, Help and return. Distinct earlier candidates validate other changed access/update paths; this is not one complete green run.
fixes: Controlled paid PWA uses the same canonical globe application root as native; public-site presentation remains scoped to the public site.
One existing global locale control moves into the active collection header; auth, worker, selected book and scene ownership are retained.
One notice portal moves into the modal focus boundary; notices consume their own row and reserve root control space without resizing the globe.
Nineteen selected canonical image files are now included in the PWA base; eight also extend the existing native selection. Original provenance and bytes retained.
Canonical book artwork uses its existing text fallback if an allowed image fails; no invented art or facts.
Product routes no longer invoke the website #books scroll writers. The mobile reader waits for real nonzero layout; only panel content scrolls, and the fixed outer frame cannot scroll.

rootVisualReview.scope: Actual a5 mobile RU/EN book and EN Help PNGs: header/locale/return visible, selected 1984 card visible, canonical cover rendered. These are Chrome QA screenshots, not native or exact-RC screenshots.

limitations: Earlier failures are preserved with exact source/build identities. No later source identity is assigned to an earlier run.
Physical devices, PWA OS installation, corrected iOS runtime, full onboarding/child/commerce, original interactive 3D Planetka and complete bilingual/content/legal/store/RC approval remain open.
